title: Jill's Dairy — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm female vocal 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage farm duet
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Jill's dairy sits at dawn beside the msasa trees
The morning mist rolls through the paddock on the breeze
She talks to every cow by name before the milking starts
The dairy is her kingdom and she tends it with her heart

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Jill anomuka mangwanani, anoenda kumadhibhi
[Jill rises at dawn, she goes to the dairy]
Anorova zvipfuyo zvake, anozviziva zvose
[She greets her cattle, she knows them all]
Mukaka unotiririka, unoenda kunze
[The milk flows out, going to the world]
Jill ane moyo wakasimba, anoita basa rake
[Jill has a strong heart, she does her work]

[Chorus — English]
Jill's dairy, Jill's dairy
The cows come home at golden light
Jill's dairy, Jill's dairy
She keeps the farm alive through every night

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
UJill uvuka ekuseni, aye ebayeni
[Jill wakes early, she goes to the dairy yard]
Izinkomo zikhala, zizwa izwi lakhe
[The cows call out, they hear her voice]
Ubisi lwehlela, luyimpilo yethu
[The milk flows down, it is our life]
UJill uthanda umhlabathi wakhe, akalali
[Jill loves her land, she does not rest]

[Outro — All three languages]
Jill's dairy… Madhibhi aJill… IBhodi likaJill
At the break of day — Mangwanani uchena — Ekuseni
The gardens still growing
